title: 第二章 我不要钱，我只要你
novel_title: 救命！我的神煞师父怎么天天亲我
content_zh:
这些人是来杀他的，姜无念才反应过来。

    她又不想傅烬川死，但动手杀人的因果太重了。

    怎么办？

    明明算过，

    她是可以帮他化解此劫的。

    纠结半天，一抬头，正对上走来的一群人。

    大眼瞪小眼。

    “啊！！有……有鬼啊！”

    这一声吼，给姜无念吓一跳。

    为首的男人看见浑身是血，披头散发的姜无念，吓得魂飞魄散，瘫软在地。

    刚才离得远没看清，还以为是个什么破袋子被风吹的摇晃。

    走近了才看见居然是......

    这荒郊野岭的，轻飘飘的，不是鬼是啥！

    姜无念愣了愣，垂眸看了眼自己，瞬间明白了。

    算到自己能解傅烬川的死劫，没想到是这么个解法。

    当真是机关算尽不如命运轻描一笔。

    当鬼就当鬼吧。

    瞥向倒地的傅烬川，玩心大起，轻飘飘地走到他面前，假装低头撕咬，长发垂落，只露出一双狭长眼尾和染血的嘴角。

    等人靠近，她猛地抬头，露出一口白牙，舔了舔滴血的嘴角，喉咙里发出阴森的嘶鸣，用了点灵力加持特效，更是云雾缭绕，3D环绕。

    “擦……你妈的，快开车跑！”

    那群人本就亏心事干得多，被她这么一吓，顿时慌不择路，屁滚尿流地上车就跑。

    姜无念趁机将傅烬川拖进密林深处，确认安全后，才压低声音轻笑，在漆黑的丛林里听起来还有些瘆人。

    把人安置在树下，生起火堆，蹲在一旁扯了衣角，细心包扎他流血的手臂。

    包着包着，目光又不自觉飘向傅烬川的嘴唇，小声嘟囔：“救你可耗费了不少灵力，有因有果，你得还我。”

    说完，干脆又吻了上去。

    正汲取得忘乎所以，傅烬川被她的动静惊醒，缓缓睁眼。

    他猛地偏头躲开，戒备地盯着姜无念，唯一能动的左手，紧紧攥起一块尖锐的石头。
content_en:
These people came to kill him, and Jiang Wu Nian finally realized.

    She didn't want Fu Jinchuan to die, but the consequences of killing him were too heavy.

    what to do?

    I've obviously calculated it,

    She can help him resolve this disaster.

    After struggling for a long time, I looked up and faced a group of people walking towards me.

    Big eyes stare at small eyes.

    "Ah!! There is... there is a ghost!"

    This roar startled Jiang Wu Nian.

    When the leading man saw Jiang Wunian, who was covered in blood and disheveled, he was so frightened that he collapsed on the ground.

    I was too far away to see it clearly just now, so I thought it was some kind of broken bag that was shaking in the wind.

    As I got closer, I saw that it was...

    This light and airy thing in the wilderness is nothing but a ghost!

    Jiang Wu Nian was stunned for a moment, looked down at himself, and understood instantly.

    I thought I could solve Fu Jinchuan's death, but I didn't expect such a solution.

    Seriously, it is better to take fate lightly than to calculate it as a mechanism.

    Just be a ghost.

    Glancing at Fu Jinchuan who was lying on the ground, he became playful and walked up to him lightly, pretending to lower his head and bite. His long hair fell down, revealing only a pair of narrow eyes and the corners of his mouth stained with blood.

    When someone came closer, she raised her head suddenly, exposed her white teeth, licked the corners of her bloody mouth, and let out a sinister hissing in her throat. She used some spiritual power to enhance the special effects, making it even more cloudy and 3D surrounding.

    "Oh...fuck you, drive away!"

    That group of people had done a lot of bad things, but when she was so frightened, they immediately panicked, got into the car and ran away in a mess.

    Jiang Wunian took the opportunity to drag Fu Jinchuan deep into the jungle. After confirming that it was safe, he lowered his voice and chuckled, which sounded a bit scary in the dark jungle.

    He placed the man under the tree, lit a fire, squatted aside and pulled off his clothes, and carefully bandaged his bleeding arm.

    Wrapping it up, his eyes unconsciously drifted to Fu Jinchuan's lips, and he muttered in a low voice: "It took a lot of spiritual power to save you. There is a cause and a result, and you have to pay me back."

    After saying that, he simply kissed her again.

    Just as he was forgetting what he was absorbing, Fu Jinchuan was awakened by her movement and slowly opened his eyes.

    He jerked his head away and stared at Jiang Wu Nian warily. The only left hand he could move tightly grasped a sharp stone.
title_en: Chapter 2 I don’t want money, I just want you
